tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and it is not turned off for local work. Local testing uses self-signed certificates, which are trusted for testing, rather than bypassing verification. Connections use https everywhere, with no plaintext exception, since certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
tool_input.description: Write the TLS verification policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says that:

- TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included.
- Local testing uses self-signed certificates instead of bypassing verification.
- Connections use https everywhere, with no plaintext exception.

I took this from the three current Muninn records (#31, #32, #35). The paragraph doesn't mention the retired dev-build exception.

I didn't use the later episode saying plain http is fine for internal hosts. It isn't a recorded decision, and the recorded "https everywhere, no plaintext exception" decision (#35) contradicts it.

The `docs/policies` directory didn't exist, so I created it. Muninn also reported a warning that 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it.
